reviewed_by: Claude: iPhone app Butler mode parity
reason: The iPhone app (NebulaShell/1.0) now shows the desktop Butler mode page as its Butler tab instead of the docked Butler panel. Shell routes gain /butler (ButlerModePage); /projects/<id>/butler and other project links redirect to /butler?project=<id>; the Projects tab bar and 'Ask Butler about' open it. In the shell, Butler mode hides Exit Butler mode, Esc exit, 'Open full Nebula' and the chat popup's 'Open in workbench' (there is no full Nebula behind it); More → All projects opens the Projects snapshot. The docked panel mode (docked/dockFooter, project select, CSS) is removed, and the shell's full-screen panel class no longer applies while Butler mode embeds the panel. Frontend selects the Butler mode board test (new iPhone-app case), the chat popup test (no workbench link), and the assistant/launcher tests for the removed docked mode. Playwright selects area:butler-mode for the desktop page this touches and the ios-assistant-only entries, whose mocked and real-Core LAN journeys are rewritten for Butler mode. Python selects the product index digest test for the settings-assistant doc change.
exclusions: ios-assistant-only/assistant-real-webkit-390 is not selected: its outage step (Retry connection after core.restart) times out identically on unmodified origin/main d0f987d because WebKit self-recovers to the degraded banner; the same journey passes on assistant-real-chromium-390 and assistant-real-desktop. No native code changed (the iPhone app bundles this UI). No full-suite approval.
